relevance_note: Table 2 lists each of the 58 genetically confirmed SSADHD participants by number with both ALDH5A1 alleles and zygosity ("Allelic variants, zygosity, resultant proteins combination, and eventual protein impairment effect of the SSADHD patients included in the study").
method_note: Cohort genotype-phenotype paper (58 participants of the SSADHD natural history study). A Python script transcribed Table 2 (58 numbered patient rows: Allele_1, Allele_2, Zygosity) and Table 1 (nucleotide-to-protein mapping); I checked the output against both tables. Labels: Table 2's 'Patient' column holds bare numbers, so each person is 'Table 2 #<n>' (the text refers to the same numbers as '#n' / 'patient # n'). Homozygous patients get one variant row, compound heterozygotes two. Protein descriptions (e.g. W204X) come from the Table 1 row for the same nucleotide variant; splice-site and 6p22.3 deletion rows have no protein value. Variant type is filled only where the paper states a class for that exact variant: 'Splice site' in Table 1; missense for c.1226G > A, c.278G > T, c.803G > A, c.1005C > A (Results text); nonsense for c.1234C > T (text) and for #1's c.612G > A ('#1 ... two nonsense variants'); deletion of 6p22.3 'in its entirety' recorded as large deletion/CNV. Pathogenicity left 'not reported': the only statements ('the 32 allelic variants ... were pathogenic', 'all missense variants were determined to have a pathogenic clinical significance') are about the cohort's variants in general (D-29). Consanguinity 'yes' only for the nine 'Homozygosis*' rows (Table 2 note '*Consanguinity.'); unmarked rows left 'not reported'. Clinical diagnosis basis from the group statement that enrolled subjects were 'genetically confirmed'. No sex, age, ethnicity or treatment is given per patient. All phenotype data (Table 4, Results) are counts by protein group, so no phenotypic_features rows and all checklist items are 'not reported'. CSS quartile membership (#1, #5, ... mildest; #4, #14, ... most severe) is a severity score, not a feature, and was not recorded. Contradictions and problems: (1) the text describes 'patient # 59' (c.1015–3C > G plus c.1234C > T, severe course with drug-resistant seizures), but Table 2 has only 58 rows; the same genotype is Table 2 #55. I did not create a 59th person and did not move #59's features to #55; needs human resolution. (2) Table 2 #37 Allele_1 is printed 'c.278C > T' while Table 1 and the text give c.278G > T (C93F); recorded as printed, protein left null. (3) Table 2 #44 is printed 'c608C > T' / 'c608C >T' (no dot); recorded as printed, protein P203L taken from Table 1 c.608C > T. (4) Table 1 gives R173C for c.517C>T but the text calls it 'A173C'; Table 1 gives G520R for c.1558G > C but the text says 'G520A'; Table 2 writes 'G176E' where Table 1 gives G176R. Protein values follow Table 1. (5) Table 1 prints 'C.1226G > A' with a capital C. (6) The text says all 13 top-quartile subjects had stability/folding/oligomerization impairments but also that #1 had no protein; and #34 (Table 2: C93F, stability/folding) is listed among severe subjects said to be all catalysis-impaired. Not used for any value. First author: header prints 'Latzer Itay Tokatly'; recorded 'Latzer' as the header's first token, although the reference list prints 'Tokatly LatzerI' for this author.
